about_the_game:
Hurry up ! You only have 15 minutes.

Prison Escape Simulator is a single-player parkour, roguelike action, adventure, escape, and survival game. Run, kill, hide, avoid deadly traps, explore endless mysterious escape routes, and escape the island.

Falling rocks, deadly traps, police, maze, giant waves, changing weather, height, and limited time. Can you overcome them all?

Story of the Game

The prisoner is in the world’s highest security prison. His only chance to reunite with his family is to escape. Survive and escape Everything is in your hands. Survive and escape.

Will you be able to escape from prison?

This survival-themed escape game will take your breath away. Experience an action-packed adventure and parkour challenge you can play endlessly. Explore the mysterious island and find your escape route.

Exciting Parkour

Enjoy intense downhill parkour and show off your skills.

Find your favorite weapon and fight.

Escape the maze

Learn to use a zipline, helicopter, parachute and boat.

A Unique Experience

Enjoy the thrill of descending the mountain, monitor security cameras, immerse yourself in the story, fight with a variety of weapons, and survive.

Enjoy original music inspired by Hans Zimmer

Experience a unique adventure with unlimited different endings and countless escape routes every time you play. Add the game to your wishlist to be among the first to try this one-of-a-kind experience.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10+
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10+
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
